text:
paul ng: quick follow from the all-hands Q&A — PMs asked for a compact, machine-readable timeline + owners for API / Console / Optimize so squads can pin sprint scope. cc @jess carter
jess carter: short answer: API GA (target week of 2026-08-17), Console invite beta (target late Sep), Optimize v1 (target mid-Nov). i'll publish a small machine-readable timeline and checklist.
rita (product): request: please include exact code freeze windows, infra freeze hints, and rollback triggers. our squads need deterministic rules.
omar (infra): also need fallback prewarm counts per region and model-family names so we can reserve capacity.
jess carter: agreed. proposed high-level windows: API code freeze: 2026-08-03..2026-08-16 (GA 2026-08-17), Console beta feature-freeze: 2026-09-12..2026-09-25 (pilot onboarding late Sep), Optimize v1 freeze: 2026-10-24..2026-11-07 (launch mid-Nov). will publish final table.
paul ng: gating bullets we need in the checklist? PMs want the minimum pass criteria.
jess carter: minimal gates: API GA = 48h staging stability >= 99.9% + no regressions on critical evals. Console beta = RBAC + audit export + 2 pilot signoffs. Optimize v1 = validated quant profiles + auto cost-reporting showing >=15% estimated savings on sample dedicated workloads + <2% quality regression.
rita (product): rollback triggers? please be specific so ops folks can wire alerts.
jess carter: rollback triggers: sustained p99 > 2x baseline for 5 minutes OR error-rate spike >0.5% for 10 minutes OR failing canary checks for 3 consecutive intervals -> automatic rollback. we'll include pseudo-config snippets in the one-pager.
omar (infra): prewarm guidance? we can't prewarm unlimited variants.
jess carter: prewarm two fallback variants per family in primary regions (NA, EU): one moderate-quant and one conservative quant. secondary regions default to on-demand. table with counts by family will be in the doc.
rita (product): one more: billing/opt-in questions for Optimize pilots — will there be credit offers or new meters? finance needs copy.
jess carter: Optimize pilots get an early-adopter credit bundle; no new billing meters at v1. recommendations may suggest enabling quantized variants which lower compute spend. billing team will get a FAQ.
paul ng: can product publish: 1) one-pager timeline table, 2) gates checklist, 3) fallback matrix, 4) pilot signup form, 5) tiny FAQ (billing / residency / concierge) by EOD Friday? engineering must lock sprint scope.
jess carter: yes. will publish the package. tagging @release-bot to create a tracking item. :white_check_mark:
release-bot: Created RW-PUB-9142 "Publish release package: timeline + gates + fallback matrix + pilot form" assigned to jess carter, rita (product), omar (infra), due 2026-07-09.
paul ng: awesome. i'll circulate to PMs and Eng leads once it's live. thanks everyone. :rocket:
